title: Coca-Cola 1886 yilda kuniga o'rtacha 9 stakan sotilgan

scenes.text: Coca-Cola 1886 yilda chiqqanida, birinchi yili kuniga o'rtacha atigi 9 stakan sotilgan.
scenes.keywords: single glass of soda on wooden table

scenes.text: Uni Atlantadagi dorixonachi Jon Pemberton tayyorlagan edi.
Ichimlik Jeykobs dorixonasida stakani 5 sentdan sotilardi.
scenes.keywords: soda glass poured on counter close up

scenes.text: Bu kuniga taxminan 45 sent degani edi.
scenes.keywords: few coins on counter close up

scenes.text: Bugun Coca-Cola 200 dan ortiq mamlakat va hududda sotiladi.
scenes.keywords: busy city street crowd evening lights

scenes.text: Kichik boshlanish keyingi natijani oldindan belgilab bermaydi.
scenes.keywords: young entrepreneur opening shop door morning

description: Coca-Cola 1886 yilda Atlantada chiqqanida, birinchi yili kuniga o'rtacha atigi 9 stakan sotilgan, har biri 5 sentdan. Bugun u 200 dan ortiq mamlakat va hududda sotiladi. Sening birinchi natijang kichik bo'lsa, davom etasanmi?
source: The Coca-Cola Company: History, The Birth of a Refreshing Idea (1886, Jacobs' Pharmacy, 5 cents a glass, first-year sales averaged nine drinks per day), https://www.coca-colacompany.com/about-us/history/the-birth-of-a-refreshing-idea ; Georgia Historical Society: A State of Innovation, The Coca-Cola Company (about nine glasses a day), https://www.georgiahistory.com/a-state-of-innovation-the-coca-cola-company/ ; Atlanta Magazine: The first glass of Coca-Cola is served, https://www.atlantamagazine.com/thisweek/first-glass-of-coke-served-1886/ . Note: nine is a first-year daily average, not every day.
